stderr_redirect_strategy: BOTH sys.stdout AND sys.stderr redirected to /dev/null. Required because cmd_validate's failing-input path prints JSON to STDOUT ({'valid': false, 'error': ...}) — without stdout redirect the log filled at ~700k lines/sec to 12GB+ in 5 minutes.
notes: Lower iter rate (~210k/s vs ~700k/s for stderr-only redirect) because Python's print() has to route through the devnull stream object on every iteration — extra Python overhead per call. Still achieved 33M iters in 310s. Two re-runs were needed: first attempted only stderr redirect filled the log to 12GB (239M lines) before timeout. Second run with full stdout+stderr redirect succeeded.
